Please note:

Mr. Shapoorji Pallonji Mistry owns 50% of the significant beneficial interest in the Reporting Company through members of the Reporting Company.

The remaining significant beneficial interest in the Reporting Company which was previously held by the Late Mr. Cyrus Pallonji Mistry, upon his demise now vests with his two sons, Mr. Firoz Cyrus Mistry and Mr. Zahan Cyrus Mistry. According, Mr. Firoz Cyrus Mistry and Mr. Zahan Cyrus Mistry jointly holds 50% significant beneficial ownership in the Reporting Company through members of the Reporting Company.

As a result, the forms BEN-1 and e-forms BEN-2, reflects the combined significant beneficial ownership of Mr. Firoz Cyrus Mistry and Mr. Zahan Cyrus Mistry in the Reporting Company through members of the Reporting Company.
